locations.title: Algal Bloom in Harbor Zone
locations.summary: Dense algal bloom detected spanning approximately 200m of Mission Creek canal. Water discoloration consistent with harmful cyanobacteria.
analysis: Chlorophyll-a concentration estimated at 45 µg/L (threshold: 10 µg/L)
Water surface temperature anomaly of +3.2°C above seasonal baseline
Dissolved oxygen likely depressed in bloom zone
Potential microcystin toxin risk for local wildlife

metrics.Dissolved O₂: 3.2 mg/L (high) — Below minimum for aquatic life
metrics.Turbidity: 42 NTU (elevated) — Reduced visibility from bloom density

locations.impact: Bloom correlates with 48-hour warming trend and upstream nutrient loading from recent storm runoff. Similar blooms at 3 other Bay Area sites this week.

locations.title: Storm Drain Contamination
locations.summary: Orange-brown discharge from storm drain outfall at south end of Ocean Beach. Industrial runoff characteristics with visible foam formation.
analysis: Visible iron oxide coloration indicating metal-laden discharge
Foam formation suggests surfactant contamination
Discharge plume extending ~50m into surf zone
No posted advisory at beach access points

metrics.Heavy Metals: 78 idx (high) — Iron and copper above EPA recreation limits
metrics.E. coli: 640 MPN (elevated) — Above 320 MPN swim advisory threshold

locations.impact: Source traced to construction site 0.4mi upstream. Similar events increasing 23% year-over-year at Bay Area outfalls.

locations.title: Wildfire Smoke Plume
locations.summary: Heavy smoke plume from foothill region reducing visibility to 0.8 miles. AQI readings in hazardous range across Griffith Park area.
analysis: PM2.5 at 285 µg/m³ (hazardous threshold: 250)
Visibility reduced to approximately 0.8 miles
Smoke composition consistent with chaparral combustion
Wind direction suggests plume will affect downtown by 6PM

metrics.CO: 12 ppm (elevated) — Carbon monoxide from incomplete combustion

locations.impact: Wildfire started 6 hours ago in Angeles National Forest. 200+ acres burned. Smoke advisory for 2.3M residents in LA basin.

locations.title: Oil Sheen on Harbor Water
locations.summary: Iridescent oil film covering ~400m² of harbor surface near container terminal. Hydrocarbon rainbow patterns clearly visible in photo.
analysis: Oil film thickness estimated 1-5 µm based on color patterns
Rainbow sheen indicates petroleum-based hydrocarbon
Source appears to be bilge discharge or fuel transfer spill
No containment boom deployed at time of photo

metrics.Oil Coverage: 400 m² (high) — Growing from initial 50m² over 2 hours
metrics.Wind Speed: 4 mph (low) — Low wind causing sheen to concentrate

locations.impact: Third oil sheen at this terminal in 60 days. Coast Guard investigation pending. Migratory bird habitat 0.5mi south.

locations.title: Refinery Flare Event
locations.summary: Abnormally large flare at Texas City refinery complex. Black smoke indicates incomplete combustion. SO₂ odor detectable at 2-mile radius.
analysis: Flare height estimated 40m, 3x normal operation
Black smoke particulates suggest equipment malfunction
SO₂ at fence line likely exceeding 75 ppb NAAQS
Flare event duration: 45+ minutes and ongoing

metrics.PM10: 195 µg/m³ (high) — Black particulate from incomplete burn
metrics.VOCs: 88 ppb (high) — Benzene and toluene detectable downwind
metrics.H₂S: 35 ppb (elevated) — Rotten egg odor at 2mi radius

locations.impact: 3 schools within 5-mile downwind zone. 7th reportable flare event at this facility this year. Community health alert issued.

locations.title: Mass Fish Kill Event
locations.summary: ~5,000 dead fish along 0.5-mile stretch of Galveston Bay. Multiple species affected. Dissolved oxygen at lethal levels.
analysis: Dissolved oxygen at 1.2 mg/L (lethal below 2.0)
Water temperature 34°C, well above seasonal norm
No visible algal bloom — hypoxia from nutrient loading
Fish showing no external lesions, consistent with suffocation

metrics.Dissolved O₂: 1.2 mg/L (critical) — Fatal: below 2.0 minimum for fish

locations.impact: Dead zone expanding. NOAA vessel dispatched. Coincides with record Gulf surface temps and spring fertilizer runoff.

locations.title: Invasive Python Nest
locations.summary: Burmese python nest with 47 eggs in critical wading bird nesting area. Adult female (16ft) captured. Within core wood stork breeding habitat.
analysis: Nest 200m from active wood stork colony
Egg count (47) indicates peak reproductive fitness
GPS data shows individual traveled 12mi in 30 days
Recent mammal predation evidence (raccoon remains) nearby

metrics.Proximity: 200 m (critical) — Within endangered bird buffer zone

locations.impact: Python population estimated at 100K+. Native mammals declined 90%+ in invaded areas. This nest threatens last wood stork breeding colony in South FL.

locations.title: Coral Bleaching Event
locations.summary: Widespread coral bleaching across 2-acre patch reef at 15ft depth. 80% of staghorn and elkhorn coral showing white skeletal exposure.
analysis: Reef temp: 31.8°C (bleaching threshold: 29.5°C)
Bleaching severity: 80% of colonies affected
Staghorn coral — federally threatened species
No disease signs; purely thermal stress bleaching

metrics.ESA Species: 3 at risk (critical) — Staghorn, elkhorn, pillar coral

locations.impact: 3rd consecutive year of bleaching at this reef. NOAA Alert Level 2 for all South Florida. Recovery unlikely without cooling in 14 days.

locations.title: Agricultural Nutrient Runoff
locations.summary: Green-brown nutrient plume extending 1.2 miles from Eastern Shore agricultural drainage into Chesapeake Bay. Phosphate 4x baseline.
analysis: Plume visible in satellite imagery spanning 1.2mi
Source: poultry farm drainage after 2-inch rainfall
Phosphate at 0.8 mg/L, 4x bay ambient
Nitrogen loading at 45 kg/day at this outfall

metrics.Sediment: 180 mg/L (elevated) — Topsoil erosion from unprotected fields

locations.impact: Chesapeake Bay receives 300M lbs of nitrogen annually. This drainage serves 12 poultry operations. Dead zone expanded 15% this summer.

locations.title: Microplastic Contamination
locations.summary: Water samples from Detroit River near Belle Isle show microplastic at 12,400 particles/m³ — 6x the Great Lakes average.
analysis: Dominant types: polyethylene (45%), polypropylene (32%)
Size range: 100µm-2mm (microplastic classification)
Sources: tire wear, textile fibers, packaging
Biofilm on particles = potential pathogen vector
locations.impact: Great Lakes hold 22M tons of plastic. Detroit River is a major transport corridor to Lake Erie. Microplastics found in 83% of regional tap water.

locations.title: Old-Growth Logging Encroachment
locations.summary: Fresh clear-cut 150m from designated old-growth preserve. ~8 acres of 150-300yr Douglas fir removed in violation of buffer zone.
analysis: Cut boundary violates 500m buffer zone requirement
Trees estimated 150-300 years old from stump rings
Northern spotted owl habitat in adjacent preserve
Heavy equipment soil disturbance visible

metrics.ESA Species: 3 at risk (moderate) — Spotted owl, murrelet, salmon

locations.impact: Less than 10% of original PNW old-growth remains. This cut disrupts a wildlife corridor connecting two protected areas.

locations.title: Below-Average Snowpack
locations.summary: Snowpack at 11,500ft measuring 62% of 30-year median. Early melt exposing alpine meadow at unprecedented rates for February.
analysis: Snow depth: 38" vs. 61" median (62%)
Snow water equivalent: 14.2" vs. 22.8" median
Melt rate 3x faster than historical average
Downstream reservoirs already 8% below target

metrics.Snowpack: 62% median (moderate) — 38% below normal for this date
metrics.SWE: 14.2 in (moderate) — Snow water equiv drives spring runoff

locations.impact: Colorado River serves 40M people. Low snowpack correlates with 60% increased summer wildfire risk. Water curtailment likely.

locations.title: Combined Sewer Overflow
locations.summary: Raw sewage overflow at Gowanus Canal outfall after 1.5-inch rain event. Brown turbid water with visible debris and sewage odor.
analysis: CSO discharge duration: 4+ hours after rain stopped
Estimated 30M gallons untreated sewage + stormwater
E. coli: >24,000 MPN/100mL (beach standard: 235)
Gowanus is an active Superfund site
locations.impact: NYC has 460 CSO outfalls. Gowanus is an EPA Superfund site. CSO events negate $1.5B ongoing remediation.

locations.title: Lake Michigan Algae Bloom
locations.summary: Green algae mat along 0.3-mile stretch of Montrose Beach shoreline. Distinct musty odor. No advisory posted.
analysis: Cladophora algae 2-6 inches thick accumulation
Decomposing algae creating hydrogen sulfide odor
No confirmed blue-green cyanobacteria yet
Growth linked to quagga mussel water clarity changes

metrics.Coverage: 0.3 mi (elevated) — Growing daily with onshore winds

locations.impact: Lake Michigan Cladophora up 5x since quagga mussel invasion. Mussels filter water, increase light, fuel algae — an invasive species cascade.

locations.title: Accelerating Coastal Erosion
locations.summary: Comparison photos show 18m of shoreline retreat in 6 months. Infrastructure now at water edge. Barrier island near breakthrough.
analysis: Land loss rate: 3m/month, 2x historical average
Barrier island width reduced to <100m at narrowest
Saltwater intrusion advancing into freshwater marsh
Hurricane season vulnerability significantly increased

metrics.Island Width: 95 m (critical) — Near breakthrough to open water
metrics.Elevation: 1.2 ft ASL (critical) — Below storm surge threshold

locations.impact: Louisiana loses a football field of land every 100 minutes. This island protects $2.8B infrastructure and 12K residents. Breakthrough expected in 18 months.

locations.title: Transboundary Smoke Drift
locations.summary: BC wildfire smoke creating persistent haze over Portland metro. AQI fluctuating Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy for 36 hours.
analysis: Source: 3 large fires in BC, ~600 miles north
Temperature inversion trapping smoke at surface
PM2.5 oscillating 85-165 µg/m³ over 24 hours
Entirely transboundary — no local fire source

metrics.PM2.5: 124 µg/m³ (high) — Very Unhealthy for all groups

locations.impact: PNW smoke seasons have doubled since 2000. Transboundary smoke affects 4.2M people with no fire management options.

locations.title: Urban Heat Island Extreme
locations.summary: Surface temp mapping shows Midtown pavement at 147°F — 23°F above tree-canopy neighborhoods 2 miles away. Heat index 118°F.
analysis: Asphalt surface: 147°F vs. 124°F in canopy areas
Ambient air: 104°F (heat index 118°F)
Zero shade on 6-block commercial corridor
HVAC exhaust adding to urban heat canyon effect
locations.impact: Urban heat islands cause 1,300+ excess US deaths annually. Atlanta lost 15% tree canopy since 2008. Low-income areas 5-8°F hotter.

locations.title: Potomac Sediment Plume
locations.summary: Heavy sediment discharge into Potomac visible from Key Bridge. Brown turbidity plume 0.5mi downstream from Rock Creek outfall.
analysis: Secchi disk visibility: 8" (normal: 36")
Sediment load at 450 mg/L (4.5x ambient)
Stormwater carrying oils, road salt, litter
Plume reaching DC drinking water intake
locations.impact: Rock Creek watershed is 75% impervious surface. Every 1-inch rain triggers CSO and sediment discharge. Green infrastructure 60% behind plan.
